versions.changelog:
- Added a new "Security Considerations" section in SKILL.md, explaining safe usage and potential risks with URL/file input.
- No functional changes to code; documentation only.
- Provided details on input trust, shell safety, dependency transparency, and network behavior.

- Initial release of html2md, an aggressive HTML-to-markdown converter for agent workflows.
- Extracts main content using Mozilla Readability and converts it to clean markdown with Turndown.
- Strips navigation, ads, footers, cookie banners, and social CTAs for clutter-free results.
- Supports token budgeting, multiple input types (URL, local file, stdin), and various output flags including JSON mode.
- Provides robust error handling for invalid inputs, timeouts, and non-HTML content.
- Ideal for research, content extraction, and web scraping automation.
